chunks: Yaqub ibn Yusuf ibn Yaqub narrated to us. He said: Abd al-Rahman al-Khayti informed us. He said: Ahmad ibn Yahya al-Awdi narrated to us. He said: Hasan ibn Husayn al-Urni narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Yusuf narrated to us from Sharik from Mansur from Rib'i from Hudhayfa.
He was asked about Ali (peace be upon him), so he said: That is the best of people; no one doubts regarding him except a hypocrite.

key_terms.منافق: Hypocrite -- one who conceals disbelief while outwardly professing faith

ai.seo_question: What did Hudhayfa say about Ali ibn Abi Talib according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith, Hudhayfa was asked about Ali (as) and replied that Ali is the best of people, and no one doubts this except a hypocrite. This parallels the previous narration from Aisha (19:3) but uses 'hypocrite' (munafiq) instead of 'disbeliever' (kafir), escalating the moral condemnation.
